name: hairline-sliver
why: A 0.25 mm wall between a through hole and a blind recess, 1 mm tall: 4.25 - 1 - 3 between two parallel circles, the shape of the control box's 0.457 mm plate defect. Swept with 200 samples: the sweep alone read 1.000 there before the face-pair search (0.265 at 6000); the search finds the two cylinders from the geometry, settles their least distance along its line, and the ball there reads the closed form to the micron.
